title: Fault diagnosis in a multiphase process
summary: Detecting anomalies while checking that a model is not learning the wrong shortcut.
overview: A study of fault diagnosis using a public dataset from a multiphase experimental process.
constraints: Operating regime and fault labels can be correlated, creating misleading shortcuts for a classifier.
contribution: I wrote the Smart Factories study and investigated the diagnostic approach. The experimental plant and public data acquisition were not my work.
approach: The analysis considers operating conditions, temporal separation of samples and a multiclass Random Forest model.
results: The report gives classification results within the studied regime. Its key contribution is the examination of the relationship between operating regime and anomaly labels.
limits: Results are limited to the dataset, fault cases and operating conditions studied; they are not general industrial deployment performance.
